data.exact_reserve_text: The 2014 Property results benefited from a lack of major loss events during the calendar year, as well as favourable loss development which resulted in releases from prior year reserves. The limited loss activity, in part, has led to the difficult market conditions referred to above. US Casualty business has faced difficult market conditions for some time as loss experience has been relatively benign in recent years. The book continues to perform very well and it has been possible again to release reserves from prior years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported favourable development on prior years, particularly in Property and US Casualty, resulting in releases of prior year reserves. This was driven by benign loss experience and a lack of major loss events in 2014. No gross quantified prior-year movement was provided in the financial notes available; the report describes the movements qualitatively.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found in the available notes. The report contains qualitative statements of releases for Property and US Casualty but no quantified gross prior-year development amount; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. No claims development triangle or 'movement in prior year' table was present in the provided pages. Premium and reserve figures were presented in GBP '000 in the source and have been converted to millions.
